text:
Maria G: quick heads-up — I'm primary for the 18:00-02:00 PT window but my flight just got delayed. I can probably cover until 19:30, but need someone to take primary for the rest. there is also an ongoing page for embeddings flakiness (see incident bot).

SRE Bot: Page triggered: #INC-2026-0315-embeds — elevated error rate on /v1/embeddings (region us-west-2). Pager sent to @Maria G (primary).

Maria G: posting current state: errors spike at ~18:07, some 503s and timeout retries. slow/gc on the embed runtime. I started the mitigation steps in runbook (link below). I can hand off if someone can pick up full primary. @Ajay K can you cover 19:30-02:00? :airplane:

Ajay K: I can take 19:30-02:00. will be online and available. do you want me to follow the runbook from the top or hand over context?

Maria G: please take over full on-call actions (pager routing, postmortem lead if needed). current mitigations done: restarted the embed worker pool, rolled forward a config rollback of `embed.max_seq_len` to 2048, enabled prefix cache. still seeing intermittent 5xxs. runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/Embed-Service-Runbook

Dmitri P: if you're swapping, annotate the incident with "handoff: Ajay K primary" and attach the `kubectl` output you ran. small note — metrics show a growing KV cache eviction rate coinciding with the spike. could be a quantization cache churn.

Maria G: copying logs and commands I ran:

```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
NAME                     READY   STATUS             RESTARTS
embed-worker-0           2/3     CrashLoopBackOff   4
embed-worker-1           3/3     Running            0
proxy-embed-5            2/2     Running            0
\nkubectl -n inference logs embed-worker-0 --tail=120
2026-03-15T18:07:12Z ERROR kvcache.go:214 KVCache miss for prefix abc123
2026-03-15T18:07:13Z WARN  runtime.go:98 slow inference batch (p95 1.4s)
2026-03-15T18:08:01Z ERROR http/server.go:345 upstream 503: backend overloaded
```

Maria G: I also toggled `embed.pool_size` from 12 -> 6 on the worker that was crashing (temp); that dropped the OOMs on that pod but doesn't fix tail latency.

Ajay K: got it. I'll take over. clicking through runbook now. My initial plan: 1) promote a healthy replica to primary routing, 2) scale up proxy layer by +2 for us-west, 3) if stable > 10m, do controlled restart of embed-worker-0. I will also add a temporary reroute to dedicated fallback variant if error rate > 5%.

Lex R: FYI I'm shadowing as secondary for the window and can step in for pager escalation. tagging the SRE rotation bot to update schedule.

rotation-bot: On-call change requested by Maria G. Proposed swap: Maria G -> Ajay K starting 2026-03-15T19:30:00Z. Please confirm.

Ajay K: Confirmed. I accept primary from 2026-03-15T19:30:00Z to 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z.

Maria G: thanks! I've updated the incident ticket with handoff note and current actions. leaving the channel — will be reachable on DM until I board. :thumbsup:

SRE Bot: Incident update: annotation added — handoff.primary=Ajay K, handoff.started=2026-03-15T19:30:00Z. Current status: degrading -> mitigating.

Dmitri P: small ops note — if you scale proxies, remember the `proxy.conn_limit` default on canaries causes backpressure; set to 0 (unlimited) for the scale test and revert after. also add a canary header `x-embed-canary: ajay-swap-1` so we can trace.

Ajay K: good call. will push small config and monitor p50/p95. I'll post updates here every 10m or on escalate.

Lex R: added myself to participants on the incident ticket and set a watch on traces.

Maria G: appreciate the help everyone. fly safe :)

Ajay K: first update after takeover: scaled proxy +2 in us-west; error rate dropped from 7.8% -> 3.1% over 8m. promoting healthy replica for routing now. ETA controlled restart 3m.

SRE Bot: Metric alert resolved: Embed error rate above threshold (now 3.1%). Ticket remains open for monitoring.

Ajay K: controlled restart done on embed-worker-0. pod is back to Running. tail latency p95 trending down. will keep monitoring. next update in 10m.

Dmitri P: thanks for the quick swap and good runbook work. leaving a note: follow up with an eval to check quantization cache behavior under current config.

Lex R: acknowledged. I'll help with traces if they persist.

rotation-bot: On-call schedule updated: Maria G removed from primary 2026-03-15T19:30:00Z, Ajay K set as primary until 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z.

Maria G: logged out. thanks all — handoff complete.
